self_spacing_policy.note: local geometric exemption of the assembled-path arclength neighbourhood; not a paper parameter and not an optical safety distance

immutability.rule: a published curve is frozen: neither a later net nor the next scene assembly may modify it

occupancy.publication_rule: published curves are the ACTUAL primitives of a VERIFIED net path: net_id + segment_id + occupancy_revision + full geometry; nodes, control points, chord polylines and AABBs are never the occupancy

no_optical_loss_model: geometry only: no dB, no insertion loss and no crosstalk number is produced
